exposure: PPH group stratified by postoperative FIBTEM A5 value of 9.5
PPH group (> 1500 ml blood loss) vs. non-PPH group
cohort: 100 women scheduled for elective Cesarean section after being diagnosed with placenta previa
finding: Postoperative FIBTEM A5 value can be a biomarker for prolonged PPH and massive transfusion following Cesarean section in women with placenta previa.
